title: cyperus eglandulosus
intro: Cyperus eglandulosus, commonly known as the desert papyrus, is a type of sedge plant native to tropical Africa. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, diarrhea, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus eglandulosus include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various infections and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
